definitions: The process or period of testing the character or abilities of a person in a certain role, for example, a new employee.
The release of an offender from detention, subject to a period of good behaviour under supervision.
A period of time during which a person is being tested to see whether they are suitable for a job, a course of study, etc.
A period of time during which a person who has committed a crime is allowed to stay out of prison if they behave well and are supervised by a probation officer.
examples: He was given two years' probation.
The new recruits are on probation for six months.
